anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: No cross-unit liquidity arithmetic. No feature, screen, or study relates trade shares to displayed quote sizes unless the dataset's `quote_size_unit` is verified (spec §2.6); unverified or mixed units are a typed refusal; unit normalization exists only as a recorded verification act, never silent arithmetic. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: apps/backend/app/research/micro_observer.py:613 (pre-fix) served quote_depletion's share-denominated magnitude ungated; caught by the reviewer (review round 1 FAIL), fixed at the one emission site _resolve_depletion (now micro_observer.py:680-687 calling mf.require_share_denominated_magnitude_allowed) and counter-tested; whole-corpus sweep in docs/handoffs/goal-rapid-microscope-iter-2-audit.md shows 1,824,729/1,824,729 completions refused, 0 serving a raw magnitude under 'unverified'.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: No value is served before it exists. Every feature carries `anchor_at`/`observed_through`/`available_at`; a deferred construct is `unavailable` until its observations exist. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: audit B1 — micro_observer.py finalize() published a quote_depletion window the session cut short as a COMPLETED observation (unavailable: False), 36 such rows across the shipped 18-dataset corpus. Fixed by the auditor, corpus rebuilt, before/after whole-corpus sweep in docs/handoffs/goal-rapid-microscope-iter-2-audit.md (36 rows now unavailable: True / value: None), regression tests added.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: No lookahead — every value computed as-of T uses only events/bars fully completed at T. (critical)
anti_goal_violations.evidence: audit B5 — apps/backend/app/research/micro_observer.py:636/:657 (locked by tests/test_micro_observer.py:291): a price-change-terminated quote_depletion stamps observed_through at the last same-price quote, one quote BEFORE the price change that proves the window closed, so available_at is earlier than the moment the completion could be known. Scored MINOR, not critical, because the value itself reads no future event and NOTHING consumes available_at as an outcome start yet (no outcome is served this iteration). It becomes a live critical violation the moment J-05 serves outcomes conditioned on max(available_at). The spec does not settle observed_through's reading — this needs an OWNER RULING, not a developer invention (T-1).
